# orca usage

Every `orca usage` command. Ids: a full id, a unique prefix, or (projects) a name or path.

## `orca usage show [--scope <scope>] [--from <from>] [--to <to>] [--group-by <group-by>]`

tokens used per model, the caps and the spend revision

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `--scope <scope>`: all (default) or repo:<repoId>
- `--from <n>`: epoch ms
- `--to <n>`: epoch ms
- `--group-by <group-by>`: model|repo|day|week|month

## `orca usage set-cap --scope <scope> --period <period> --tokens <tokens>`

set a spend cap

- What it does: sends control verb `set-spend-cap`.
- Who may: a person: needs a person token over the socket (`orca login`, then `--as-person`).
- `--scope <scope>` (required): all|repo:<repoId>
- `--period <period>` (required): total|week|month
- `--tokens <n>` (required): the cap

## `orca usage clear-cap --scope <scope> --period <period>`

clear a spend cap

- What it does: sends control verb `clear-spend-cap`.
- Who may: a person: needs a person token over the socket (`orca login`, then `--as-person`).
- `--scope <scope>` (required): all|repo:<repoId>
- `--period <period>` (required): total|week|month

## `orca usage set-calendar --time-zone <time-zone> --week-start <week-start>`

the usage calendar's time zone and first weekday

- What it does: sends control verb `set-usage-calendar`.
- Who may: a person: needs a person token over the socket (`orca login`, then `--as-person`).
- `--time-zone <time-zone>` (required): an IANA zone
- `--week-start <n>` (required): 1 Monday .. 7 Sunday
